avg_shipping_charge AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CAST(shipping_charges AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_shipping
    FROM 
        ecommerce_order_items

high_shipping_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        order_items.product_id,
        CAST(order_items.price AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS price_val

        ecommerce_order_items order_items

        CAST(order_items.shipping_charges AS DOUBLE PRECISION) > (SELECT avg_shipping FROM avg_shipping_charge)
),

        SUM(hso.price_val) AS total_sales,

        high_shipping_orders hso

        hso.product_id = pcd.product_id

        pcd.product_category_name
)

    total_sales AS "总销售额",

WITH      residential_stores AS (
          SELECT    "Store_ID"
          FROM      toy_stores
          ),
          sales_data AS (
          SELECT    s."Product_ID",
                    SUBSTR(s."Date", 1, 7) AS sale_month,
                    SUM(
                    CAST(s."Units" AS INT) * CAST(
                    REPLACE   (TRIM(p."Product_Price"), '$', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION
                    )
                    ) AS monthly_sales
          FROM      toy_sales s
          JOIN      residential_stores rs ON s."Store_ID" = rs."Store_ID"
          JOIN      toy_products p ON s."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
          GROUP BY  s."Product_ID",
                    SUBSTR(s."Date", 1, 7)
          ),
          sales_growth AS (
          SELECT    "Product_ID",
                    sale_month,
                    monthly_sales,
                    LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY "Product_ID"
                    ORDER BY  sale_month
                    ) AS prev_sales
          FROM      sales_data
          )
SELECT    DISTINCT "Product_ID" AS "product_id",
          sale_month AS "sale_month"
FROM      (
          SELECT    "Product_ID",
                    sale_month,
                    CASE
                              WHEN monthly_sales > prev_sales THEN 1
                              ELSE 0
                    END AS is_growing
          FROM      sales_growth
          ) t
WHERE     is_growing = 1

WITH dairy_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id
    FROM
        blinkit_products
    WHERE
        category = 'Dairy & Breakfast'
),
order_products AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        oi.order_id
    FROM
        blinkit_order_items oi
        JOIN dairy_products dp ON oi.product_id = dp.product_id
),
delivery_status_data AS (
    SELECT
        op.product_id,
        CASE
            WHEN dp.delivery_status = 'On Time' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_ontime
    FROM
        order_products op
        JOIN blinkit_orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id -- 确保 op.order_id 正确引用
        JOIN blinkit_delivery_performance dp ON op.order_id = dp.order_id
),
delivery_stats AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        SUM(is_ontime) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ontime_rate
    FROM
        delivery_status_data
    GROUP BY
        product_id
)
SELECT
    product_id
FROM
    delivery_stats
WHERE
    ontime_rate < 0.9

WITH partner_stats AS (
    -- 计算配送员的总订单数和准时订单数
    SELECT
        delivery_partner_id,
        COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN delivery_status = 'On Time' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS on_time_orders
    FROM
        blinkit_delivery_performance
    GROUP BY
        delivery_partner_id
),
low_performance_filter AS (
    -- 筛选准时率低于90%的配送员及其异常订单数
    SELECT
        delivery_partner_id,
        (total_orders - on_time_orders) AS abnormal_orders
    FROM
        partner_stats
    WHERE
        (on_time_orders * 100.0) / total_orders < 90
) -- 最终输出配送员ID和异常订单数
SELECT
    delivery_partner_id AS "delivery_partner_id",
    abnormal_orders AS "abnormal_order_count"
FROM
    low_performance_filter

WITH sales_by_category_payment AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.payment_method,
        SUM(
            CAST(oi.quantity AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * CAST(oi.unit_price AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
        ) AS sales
    FROM
        blinkit_order_items oi
        JOIN blinkit_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        JOIN blinkit_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.category,
        o.payment_method
),
category_avg AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(sales) AS avg_sales
    FROM
        sales_by_category_payment
    GROUP BY
        category
)
SELECT
    scp.category AS "品类",
    scp.payment_method AS "支付方式",
    scp.sales AS "销售额",
    ca.avg_sales AS "品类平均销售额"
FROM
    sales_by_category_payment scp
    JOIN category_avg ca ON scp.category = ca.category

select result."店铺城市", result."平均开业年限", result."店铺名称", result."店铺位置", result."库存量", round(result."区域平均库存"::numeric, 2) as "区域平均库存" from (WITH store_opening_years AS (
    -- 计算每个城市的平均开业年限
    SELECT
        "Store_City",
        AVG(
            ((('2025-12-31')::date - DATE '1970-01-01') - (("Store_Open_Date")::date - DATE '1970-01-01')) / 365.25
        ) AS avg_years
    FROM
        toy_stores
    GROUP BY
        "Store_City"
),
-- 计算区域平均库存
city_avg_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_City",
        AVG(i."Stock_On_Hand") AS avg_stock
    FROM
        toy_inventory i
        JOIN toy_stores s ON i."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    GROUP BY
        s."Store_City"
),
-- 获取高于区域平均库存的店铺清单
high_inventory_stores AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_City",
        s."Store_Name",
        s."Store_Location",
        i."Stock_On_Hand" AS stock,
        c.avg_stock
    FROM
        toy_inventory i
        JOIN toy_stores s ON i."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
        JOIN city_avg_inventory c ON s."Store_City" = c."Store_City"
    WHERE
        i."Stock_On_Hand" > c.avg_stock
)

cases.first_sql:
select result."产品类别", result."店铺名称", round(result."总销售额"::numeric, 2) as "总销售额", round(result."总库存量"::numeric, 2) as "总库存量" from (WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s."Store_ID",
        p."Product_Category",
        CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(p."Product_Price", '$', ''),
                    ' ', ''
                ),
                ',', ''
            ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION
        ) AS price,
        CAST(s."Units" AS INTEGER) AS "Units"
    FROM 
        toy_sales s
        JOIN toy_products p ON s."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
),
sales_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        "Store_ID",
        "Product_Category",
        SUM("Units" * price) AS total_sales
    FROM 
        sales_data
    GROUP BY 
        "Store_ID", 
        "Product_Category"
),
inventory_data AS (
    SELECT 
        i."Store_ID",
        p."Product_Category",
        CAST(i."Stock_On_Hand" AS INTEGER) AS "Stock_On_Hand"
    FROM 
        toy_inventory i
        JOIN toy_products p ON i."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
),
inventory_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        "Store_ID",
        "Product_Category",
        SUM("Stock_On_Hand") AS total_stock
    FROM 
        inventory_data
    GROUP BY 
        "Store_ID", 
        "Product_Category"
),
combined_sales_store AS (
    SELECT 
        ss."Store_ID",
        ss."Product_Category",
        ss.total_sales,
        st."Store_Name"
    FROM 
        sales_summary ss
        JOIN toy_stores st ON ss."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        css."Store_ID",
        css."Product_Category",
        css."Store_Name",
        css.total_sales,
        COALESCE(its.total_stock, 0) AS total_stock
    FROM 
        combined_sales_store css
        LEFT JOIN inventory_summary its 
            ON css."Store_ID" = its."Store_ID" 
            AND css."Product_Category" = its."Product_Category"
),
ranked_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "Store_ID",
        "Product_Category",
        "Store_Name",
        total_sales,
        total_stock,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Product_Category" ORDER BY total_sales DESC, "Store_ID" ASC) AS rank
    FROM 
        combined_data
)
SELECT 
    "Product_Category" AS "产品类别",
    "Store_Name" AS "店铺名称",
    total_sales AS "总销售额",
    total_stock AS "总库存量"
FROM 
    ranked_data
WHERE 
    rank <= 3) as result

    SELECT
        "Store_ID",
        "Store_Open_Date" AS open_date,
        (("Store_Open_Date")::date + interval '36 months') AS third_year_date
    FROM
        toy_stores
),
valid_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_ID",
        SUM(CAST(s."Units" AS INTEGER)) AS total_units
    FROM
        toy_sales s
        JOIN store_opening_dates sod ON s."Store_ID" = sod."Store_ID"
    WHERE
        s."Date"::date >= sod.third_year_date
    GROUP BY
        s."Store_ID"
),
store_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        "Store_ID",
        SUM(CAST("Stock_On_Hand" AS INTEGER)) AS total_stock
    FROM
        toy_inventory
    GROUP BY
        "Store_ID"
),
turnover_rates AS (
    SELECT
        vs."Store_ID",
        (vs.total_units * 1.0) / si.total_stock AS turnover_rate,
        st."Store_City"
    FROM
        valid_sales vs
        JOIN store_inventory si ON vs."Store_ID" = si."Store_ID"
        JOIN toy_stores st ON vs."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
),

    SELECT
        p."Product_ID",
        p."Product_Category",
        (
            CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p."Product_Price", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) 
            - CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p."Product_Cost", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
        ) / CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p."Product_Price", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS profit_margin
    FROM
        toy_products p
    INNER JOIN
        toy_sales s
    ON
        p."Product_ID" = s."Product_ID"
),
category_avg AS (
    SELECT
        "Product_Category",
        AVG(profit_margin) AS avg_margin
    FROM
        product_profit
    GROUP BY
        "Product_Category"
)
SELECT
    "Product_ID" AS "product_id",
    "Product_Category" AS "product_category",
    profit_margin AS "profit_margin"
FROM
    product_profit
INNER JOIN
    category_avg
USING
    ("Product_Category")
WHERE
    profit_margin > avg_margin

WITH sales_rank_cte AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_ID",
        s."Product_ID",
        s."Date",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s."Store_ID", s."Product_ID" 
            ORDER BY ((s."Date")::date) DESC
        ) AS sale_rank
    FROM
        toy_sales s
    INNER JOIN
        toy_stores st 
        ON s."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
    INNER JOIN
        toy_products pr 
        ON s."Product_ID" = pr."Product_ID"
)
SELECT
    "Store_ID" AS "store_id",
    "Product_ID" AS "product_id",
    "Date" AS "date",
    sale_rank AS "sale_rank"
FROM
    sales_rank_cte

 FROM blinkit_inventory

    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        CAST(p.amount AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS order_amount
    FROM
        online_shop_orders o
        INNER JOIN online_shop_payment p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    WHERE
        p.transaction_status = 'Completed'
),
customer_summary AS (

        SUM(order_amount) AS total_amount

)
SELECT

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

    select
        product_id,
        cast(price as DECIMAL(10,2)) as price,
        cast(shipping_charges as DECIMAL(10,2)) as shipping_charges
    from
        ecommerce_order_items
),

    select
        product_id,
        product_category_name
    from
        ecommerce_products
),

    select
        p.product_category_name,
        oi.price,
        oi.shipping_charges
    from
        order_items_cte oi
        join products_cte p on oi.product_id = p.product_id
),
category_totals as (

        product_category_name,
        sum(price) as total_sales,

        product_category_name
)

    product_category_name as "产品类别",
    total_sales as "总销售额",
    total_profit as "总利润"
from
    category_totals

    total_sales > 5000

WITH sales_detail AS (
    SELECT
        p."Product_Category",
        CAST(trim(s."Units"::text) AS INT) * CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(p."Product_Price"), '$', '') AS DECIMAL) AS sale_amount
    FROM
        toy_sales s
    INNER JOIN
        toy_products p
    ON
        s."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        "Product_Category",
        SUM(sale_amount) AS category_total
    FROM
        sales_detail
    GROUP BY
        "Product_Category"
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(category_total) AS grand_total
    FROM
        category_sales
)
SELECT
    cs."Product_Category" AS "product_category",
    (cs.category_total * 100.0 / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_sales)) AS "sales_percentage"
FROM
    category_sales cs
WHERE
    cs.category_total > 50

                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE("Product_Cost", '$', ''),

                ),
                ',', ''
            ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION

                REPLACE(

        s."Store_ID", st."Store_City"
)

WITH product_store_sales AS (
    -- 步骤1: 计算每个产品在每家店铺的总销量
    SELECT
        "Store_ID",
        "Product_ID",
        SUM("Units") AS product_total_units
    FROM
        toy_sales
    GROUP BY
        "Store_ID", "Product_ID"
    HAVING
        SUM("Units") <= 10  -- 筛选销量不超过10件的产品
),

store_low_sales AS (
    -- 步骤2: 计算每家店铺的累计销量
    SELECT
        "Store_ID",
        SUM(product_total_units) AS store_low_sales_total
    FROM
        product_store_sales
    GROUP BY
        "Store_ID"
)

    p."Product_ID" AS "产品ID",

    s.store_low_sales_total AS "店铺产品累计"
FROM
    product_store_sales p
JOIN
    store_low_sales s ON p."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
ORDER BY
    p."Store_ID", p.product_total_units

)

cases.first_sql: WITH fraud_transactions AS (SELECT cu."Cust_ID", cu."Customer_Segment" FROM credit_card_fraud_base AS f JOIN credit_card_transaction_base AS t ON f."Transaction_ID" = t."Transaction_ID" JOIN credit_card_card_base AS c ON t."Credit_Card_ID" = c."Card_Number" JOIN credit_card_customer_base AS cu ON c."Cust_ID" = cu."Cust_ID" WHERE trim(f."Fraud_Flag"::text) = '1'), customer_counts AS (SELECT "Cust_ID", "Customer_Segment", COUNT(*) AS fraud_count FROM fraud_transactions GROUP BY "Cust_ID", "Customer_Segment"), segment_averages AS (SELECT "Customer_Segment", AVG(fraud_count) AS avg_fraud_count FROM customer_counts GROUP BY "Customer_Segment") SELECT cc."Cust_ID" AS "客户id", cc."Customer_Segment" AS "客户分组", cc.fraud_count AS "欺诈次数", sa.avg_fraud_count AS "平均欺诈次数" FROM customer_counts AS cc JOIN segment_averages AS sa ON cc."Customer_Segment" = sa."Customer_Segment" WHERE cc.fraud_count > sa.avg_fraud_count
